author: golem
body:
# CNS-003 concrete wire contract for acceptance

I have source-checked the attached contract. Please review /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/pcm-wire/README.md and its source-findings.md now. Proposed freeze: ordinary audio op16, INFO25 reports adapter version1/0, optional --pcm-wire on lean/pixels-lean only, same copied sink (no queue engine/second ring). The existing native descriptor/ABI is unchanged. This is a concrete acceptance request; audio16/INFO25 are source-confirmed unused in our pinned firmware, not an upstream allocation.

Important corrections: stock MOS receives at most16 BODY bytes per reply. Therefore coherent32-byte state is four PS10..PS13 fragments,14-byte body each/64 UART bytes total; WRITE/CLOSE/error PS1A acknowledgement is14-byte body/16 UART bytes. Fixed request15 bytes plus up to8 payload (23 total); token16, generation32. No C layout wire-cast. All lengths/fields/error/source-reuse rules are specified. Four-byte markers follow existing VDPL/AUDQ callback precedent and do not require an unavailable callback-length parameter. Mixed keyboard hook preserves held-key bitmap but still touches MOS transient last-key/keycount; do not equate counter increments with physical keys. One outstanding request, exact token/op/order, copy fragments inside hook; no blind WRITE retry after ambiguous timeout.

Native/wire owner-domain separation is mandatory: failed module RUN/INIT/UNLOAD closes only native-owned sink; a wire stream survives unrelated module cleanup. Explicit channel/mixer reset cancels either. OPEN needs unallocated stock channel as already corrected. Default/full/native behavior and one-ring limits stay as before; flags/control generation/copy-before-ACK remain shared. The extra adapter has an independently measured flash/RAM delta, not part of minimum native firmware by default.

Please return acceptance or specific blockers promptly. Once accepted I will record final normative interface and release your module-free stock-MOS producer preparation while implementing adapter/host/target checks. Do not test the new op before safe discovery/INFO confirms it exists, and do not implement against a silently changed layout. No need to stop your colour candidate preparation. No new human decision needed unless you identify an actual unresolved design tradeoff.
